question: Could you help me find the sellers who excel in the following categories, considering only delivered orders: the seller with the highest number of distinct customer unique IDs, the seller with the highest profit (calculated as price minus freight value), the seller with the highest number of distinct orders, and the seller with the most 5-star ratings? For each category, please provide the seller ID and the corresponding value, labeling each row with a description of the achievement.
sql:
WITH delivered_items AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        oi.product_id,
        oi.seller_id,
        p.product_category_name,
        o.customer_id,
        oi.price,
        oi.freight_value
    FROM olist_orders o
    JOIN olist_order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN olist_products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
m1_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        product_category_name,
        seller_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) as distinct_customers
    FROM delivered_items
    GROUP BY product_category_name, seller_id
),
m2_profit AS (
    SELECT 
        product_category_name,
        seller_id,
        SUM(price - freight_value) as total_profit
    FROM delivered_items
    GROUP BY product_category_name, seller_id
),
m3_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        product_category_name,
        seller_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) as distinct_orders
    FROM delivered_items
    GROUP BY product_category_name, seller_id
),
m5_reviews AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_category_name,
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(*) as five_star_count
    FROM olist_orders o
    JOIN olist_order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN olist_products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN olist_order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND r.review_score = 5
    GROUP BY p.product_category_name, oi.seller_id
),
m1_top AS (
    SELECT product_category_name, seller_id, distinct_customers, 'highest_distinct_customers' as achievement, 1 as metric_num
    FROM (
        SELECT product_category_name, seller_id, distinct_customers,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_category_name ORDER BY distinct_customers DESC) as rn
        FROM m1_customers
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
m2_top AS (
    SELECT product_category_name, seller_id, total_profit, 'highest_profit' as achievement, 2 as metric_num
    FROM (
        SELECT product_category_name, seller_id, total_profit,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_category_name ORDER BY total_profit DESC) as rn
        FROM m2_profit
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
m3_top AS (
    SELECT product_category_name, seller_id, distinct_orders, 'highest_distinct_orders' as achievement, 3 as metric_num
    FROM (
        SELECT product_category_name, seller_id, distinct_orders,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_category_name ORDER BY distinct_orders DESC) as rn
        FROM m3_orders
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
m5_top AS (
    SELECT product_category_name, seller_id, five_star_count, 'most_5_star_ratings' as achievement, 4 as metric_num
    FROM (
        SELECT product_category_name, seller_id, five_star_count,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_category_name ORDER BY five_star_count DESC) as rn
        FROM m5_reviews
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_rows FROM (
    SELECT product_category_name, seller_id, achievement, metric_num, distinct_customers as value FROM m1_top
    UNION ALL
    SELECT product_category_name, seller_id, achievement, metric_num, total_profit as value FROM m2_top
    UNION ALL
    SELECT product_category_name, seller_id, achievement, metric_num, distinct_orders as value FROM m3_top
    UNION ALL
    SELECT product_category_name, seller_id, achievement, metric_num, five_star_count as value FROM m5_top
)
